verdict.description: confirm when your windows match the profile's suggestion, adjust when you name windows or bounds of your own, keep_running when the box or group must stay as it is

safe_off_windows.description: an instance: the hours of the week it is safe to turn it off; only windows with certain=true are used

days.description: daily, weekdays, weekends, mon-fri, or mon,tue,wed

start.description: UTC hour 0-23 the box may go off

end.description: UTC hour 1-24 it must be back; under start means overnight

certain.description: true only when you would put your name to nobody using it in those hours, every week

downsize_windows.description: a group: the hours of the week it is fine to run at its floor; same shape as safe_off_windows

group_min_size.description: a group: the configured minimum that still does the job in the busy hours (fewer machines when CPU and requests per member allow); null for no change

group_max_size.description: a group: the maximum it needs; null for no change

min_off_hours.description: a better number than the default for the shortest stop worth making on this box, with the reason in reasoning; null to keep the default

schedule.description: only when you give no windows: a running window in UTC, '<days> HH-HH UTC'; null for keep_running

reasoning.description: what was looked at and why it decides the verdict

evidence.description: each line with numbers and the tool it came from

when.description: the stretch, e.g. 'Mon-Fri 08:00-18:00 UTC' or 'Thu 15:00 in one week'

is_people.description: true when people or clients caused it, false for machine chatter, jobs, deploys, backups, health checks, peers
